name: Erika
source: She always enjoys making costumes for her sister Ririka. Like Ririka, she’s a trainee witch who came from the magical world of Clarice. In contrast to Ririka, she has a quiet personality. She’s not good at sports and is the typical indoor type. Of course, she’s about the same age too, around 600 years old. She’s good at household chores and sewing, very domestic. Her dream is to become human and be a cute bride. She kindly supports Ririka’s dream of becoming a magical girl by making her costumes.
